ratings_why.fun: Each last gold is a real choice (roll to cross a Fanfare or keep it for a Reserve), and Wax Sealer, The Borrower and Ottavia make End of Turn order a puzzle; but in the fight it is mostly +1/+1 piles.
ratings_why.distinct: Two rival gold counters is new among today's tribes and goes past plain TFT interest, though at heart it is still an economy tribe that turns gold into stats.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; the open questions (sticky float, thin fight side) are tuning the designer already listed, not fixes.

points.text: Once the float is banked, a pure Hive player spends income every turn and never decides again. Making Reserve count only gold above this turn's income would ask the save-or-spend question every turn.
The fight side is thin. Winter Cluster's proposed swap (a hurt front-row unit trades places with the one behind it) would give the Hive a fight trick that reads the Purse.
Tymbal Drummer says 'gold you spent this Recruit Phase' where every other card says Spent; using the word Spent would show players it is the same counter.

standouts.why: A Hive card whose 1 gold counts as Spent, so it can tip Bandstand Horn or Maestro Tettix past their numbers depending on where it sits in reading order.
Free gold for a player who ends broke, a tax on a float, and a placement puzzle against Reserve units and Ottavia; it also feeds Madame Cigale every turn.
Rewards keeping both counters level, which pulls cards from both towns into one build and makes every gold count twice over.

weakest.why: A plain Attack-from-Purse body; it does its one job and talks to nothing else.
Three random +1/+1s at a threshold; the only interest is how you reach 7 Spent.
Health from the Purse and nothing else, so it adds to the pile of stats without making a decision.

flags.note: A 20-gold float gives ten 3-damage hits every Start of Combat, and keeping the float costs nothing each turn.
On a drain turn every Refresh past income gives every Carnival and Road unit +1/+1 permanently; 20 rolls is +20/+20 across the band.
With a golden Granary Clerk, Melissa gives 8 gold a turn; added to The Borrower, that is a big steady pile of gold beyond income for Cigale.
